SEARCH
Package domain

Class AIController

java.lang.Object
domain.AIController
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerController, Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClumsyAI, DefensiveAI, ExpertAI, OffensiveAI
public abstract class AIController extends Object implements PlayerController
Controller of a player moved by the machine (Template Method): nextActions(domain.Player, domain.Match) is the fixed part (it decides again only after its reaction time) and decide(domain.Player, domain.Match) is what each profile does.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda
